cards.name: Chamroshes' Aegis

effects.printed_clause: 3 Level 3 or lower Tuners with different names; must first be Special Summoned from Extra by shuffling those cards from GY/banishment into Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: Revive-limited custom Extra Deck procedure finds three face-up-accessible Level ≤3 Tuners with distinct codes in GY/banishment and shuffles them as procedure material/cost.

official_references.matched_structure: Alternative Extra Deck summon procedure with retained material selection; the exact three-Tuner shuffle procedure is custom.

effects.printed_clause: If Summoned this way, Extra Deck Special Summons are Synchro-only for the rest of the turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A continuous summon-success watcher recognizes SUMMON_VALUE_SELF and registers an end-turn restriction against non-Synchro Extra Deck summons.

effects.printed_clause: When Special Summoned: Special Summon a Level 2 Tuner Synchro from Extra, banish it when it leaves, and allow it to be non-Tuner for Synchro Material; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Trigger summons an eligible Level 2 Tuner Synchro, installs leave-field redirect and EFFECT_NONTUNER with standard reset, and uses id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Exact 'may be treated as non-Tuner for Synchro Material' implementation.
Special Summon with leave-field banish redirect.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to GY: change battle position of up to 3 field monsters; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed GY trigger selects 1–3 monsters on either field and calls ChangePosition with mappings for every current position; separate HOPT key.

official_references.matched_structure: Targeted temporary/state-change effect with HOPT trigger structure.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each following effect of "Chamroses' Aegis" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The two following activated effects use separate hard once-per-turn keys based on this card?s actual passcode. This enforces the clearly intended restriction despite the printed card-name typo.

official_references.matched_structure: Named hard once-per-turn effects key off the card's actual identity.

cards.audit_note: Rejected as a Lua defect. The printed typo is in the card name inside the restriction; the Lua correctly applies separate hard once-per-turn keys to the two following effects of the actual card.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
